summary: Import-time denial-of-service: unbounded memory allocation and CPU spin loop
details: element-guci-util@9.1.2's main entrypoint invokes silentInfiniteLoad(99) at the module's top level, so it runs the moment any consumer executes require('element-guci-util') or import. That function starts a setInterval that pushes 99MB Uint8Array chunks into an in-memory array every 10ms (rapid memory exhaustion) and simultaneously enters a while(true) Math.sqrt loop (CPU exhaustion). A dated guard in iconFont() only stops the loop when the local system date is after 2026-09-01, so on any machine with a clock before that date the process is destroyed on import. Package author metadata is placeholder text ("你的名字", "你的git仓库地址") and the name mimics element-ui utility tooling, consistent with a typosquat-shaped sabotage payload rather than a real utility library.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
